name: Independent on Sunday cryptic crossword No 1,538

clue.text: At regular intervals, cook treat, edible pods

indicators.note: taking letters at a fixed spacing means every second letter of the following words is kept

blocks.note: the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters of these two words

explanation.surface: Someone is told to cook a treat made from edible pods.
explanation.definitionFit: Okra is a vegetable consisting of the long green seed pods of a plant eaten cooked, as in gumbo.

clue.text: How one might describe flag on course to audience generally

indicators.note: something presented to an audience is heard rather than seen, so the sound is what counts

blocks.clueFragment: How one might describe flag on course
blocks.note: on a golf course the flag stands in the hole, so it is described as on the hole

explanation.surface: Someone tells listeners in general terms where the golf flag is.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'course' is a golf course, where a flagstick marks each hole; 'hole' and 'whole' sound identical.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom meaning taking everything into account, broadly speaking, in most respects.

clue.text: Disparage summary

blocks.note: first meaning: to criticise unfairly, a phrasal verb
second meaning: a brief account of the main points, as a noun

explanation.walkthrough: The verb form is written as two words and the noun often as one, but the letters are the same.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means belittle or criticise; as a noun it means a quick outline of the key facts.

clue.text: Obvious hope is misplaced about leader of Tories? It's excessive

indicators.note: the leader of a group is at its front, so only the first letter is taken
letters that are misplaced are out of their proper positions and must be rearranged
about means around, so the rearranged letters wrap round another piece

blocks.note: overt means open and plainly visible
taken as written, then rearranged
the first letter of Tories

explanation.surface: A political commentator says the Conservative leader's optimism is obviously misplaced and overblown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leader of Tories' looks like a party boss in the surface, but it supplies just one letter that sits inside the shuffled word.
explanation.definitionFit: Over-the-top is an informal phrase for exaggerated or going far beyond what is reasonable.

clue.text: Outburst? It's usually observed in front of a court

definitions.text: It's usually observed in front of a court

blocks.note: first meaning: a sudden barrage, as of words or shots

blocks.clueFragment: It's usually observed in front of a court
blocks.note: second meaning: in tennis this shot is typically played near the net, at the front of the court

explanation.walkthrough: The second half reads like a description of a crowd outside a law court, but the court is a tennis court.
explanation.definitionFit: A volley is a burst of many things at once, such as abuse or gunfire, and also a tennis stroke hit before the ball bounces.

clue.text: Beer yard brewed - it's full of yeast

indicators.note: brewing mixes ingredients together, so these letters are stirred into a new order

blocks.note: the eight letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Beer made in a yard is brewing with plenty of yeast.
explanation.walkthrough: Brewing beer also uses yeast, so the whole surface stays in the same kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: This dark loaf is leavened with yeast, so a description of something packed with yeast fits it cryptically.

clue.text: Short journey in spring

blocks.note: first meaning: a brief trip, especially a short flight
second meaning: a jump or leap

explanation.surface: Someone takes a brief trip in springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: Spring looks like the season, but it is the verb or noun for a leap.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a quick trip somewhere and a small jump on one foot.

clue.text: What post is replaced with no end of fuss as feature by canal?

indicators.note: letters that are replaced are put back in different positions, so they are rearranged
with no means lacking, so one letter is struck out of the collection
the end of a word is its final letter, which is the one taken

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
the final letter of fuss, which is removed

explanation.surface: Someone asks which signpost was swapped quietly along the canal.
explanation.walkthrough: WHAT POST loses one S, then the seven letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A towpath is the track running alongside a canal, once used by horses pulling barges.

clue.text: Nice, perhaps, tip in prospect?

blocks.note: first meaning: Nice is a harbour city on the French Riviera, an example of this
second meaning, read cryptically: the end of a voyage, the destination a ship sees ahead

explanation.walkthrough: Nice is the French city, not the adjective; the question mark warns that the second half is a playful description of a ship's destination.
explanation.definitionFit: Nice is a Mediterranean harbour town, and a harbour is the place a voyage ends, its endpoint coming into view.

clue.text: Triumphal building, notion originally dismissed by right-winger, senior minister

indicators.note: the original part of a word is its opening, and dismissing it sends that first letter away

blocks.note: a triumphal arch is a monumental structure
a notion is an idea; its first letter goes
short for Conservative

explanation.surface: A grand building's concept is rejected by a conservative senior politician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minister' suggests government, but here it is a church minister.
explanation.definitionFit: An archdeacon is a senior Anglican cleric ranking just below a bishop, and clergy are called ministers.

clue.text: Figure leading exercise mostly in part of plant

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped

blocks.note: a figure is a number
a drill is a training exercise; its last letter goes

explanation.surface: A fitness instructor leads most of a workout inside a greenhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leading' places the number in front of the exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: A tendril is the slender coiling shoot a climbing plant uses to grip supports.

clue.text: Give authority to newly created peer, woman ignoring a Nationalist

indicators.note: something newly created is made fresh, so these letters are formed into a new arrangement
ignoring means leaving out, so those letters are not used

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written, then removed
N is the abbreviation for Nationalist, removed

explanation.surface: A recently ennobled woman is given power while snubbing a nationalist politician.
explanation.walkthrough: PEER plus WOMAN without A and N leaves seven letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: To empower someone is to grant them power or official authority to act.

clue.text: Husband has to manage in retreat for a long time

indicators.note: an army in retreat goes back the way it came, so the letters run backwards

blocks.note: H is the abbreviation for husband
to cope is to manage or get by

explanation.surface: A husband must get by on a retreat for a lengthy period.
explanation.definitionFit: An epoch is an era, a lengthy period of history or geological time.

clue.text: Refined painter, say, in middle of beano is French?

definitions.note: an example of the answer, flagged by the question mark

indicators.note: the earlier pieces sit inside the following letters
the middle of a word is its central letters, leaving out both ends

blocks.note: U means upper-class, so refined
a painter is a rope tied to a boat's bow
the three central letters of beano

explanation.surface: An elegant artist at a lively party turns out to be French.
explanation.walkthrough: A painter here is a mooring line, not an artist. A beano is British slang for a party; U for upper-class is a crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: The French are one example of the continent's peoples, which the question mark acknowledges.

clue.text: Cheap meal prepared to include starter of broth and dessert

indicators.note: a meal that is prepared is put together, so the letters are reworked
including something puts it inside, so one letter goes within the others
a starter comes first, so only the opening letter is taken

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged
the first letter of broth

explanation.surface: A budget dinner is cooked with soup to start and a pudding to finish.
explanation.walkthrough: CHEAP MEAL rearranged, with B slipped in before the final A.
explanation.definitionFit: Peach Melba is a classic sweet course of peaches, raspberry sauce and vanilla ice cream.

clue.text: Food's entry is mismanaged, there's no more to say

indicators.note: something mismanaged is badly handled and gets jumbled out of order

blocks.note: the ten letters to be rearranged, ignoring the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A restaurant critic complains the food came out badly, and won't discuss it further.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom used to close a discussion firmly, declaring the matter settled.

clue.text: Obstruct growth in deregulated housing

indicators.note: housing means holding inside, so the letters sit within the words that follow

blocks.note: the letters run across the end of growth, all of in, and the start of deregulated

explanation.surface: An economist warns that deregulated housing markets hold back growth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Housing' looks like the property market, but it is the signal to look inside the words.
explanation.definitionFit: To hinder is to hamper or impede, getting in the way of progress.

clue.text: Damage a skimpy garment cut in gruelling event

indicators.note: something cut is trimmed short, so the final letter is removed

blocks.note: to mar is to spoil or damage
taken as written
a thong is a minimal piece of underwear or swimwear; its last letter goes

explanation.surface: A runner's tiny outfit gets ripped during a punishing race.
explanation.definitionFit: A marathon is a long-distance race of about 26 miles, and by extension any exhausting task.

clue.text: Candidate with a small point about ME country

indicators.note: about means around, so these letters surround the country

blocks.note: taken as written
S is the abbreviation for small
PT is the abbreviation for point
ME is the Middle East, and this is one of its countries

explanation.surface: A candidate makes a minor point about a Middle Eastern nation.
explanation.walkthrough: ME is the standard abbreviation for the Middle East; 'about' wraps the abbreviated point round the country.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspirant is someone who hopes to attain a position, much like an applicant or hopeful.

clue.text: Musical contributor, one in Strictly broadcast without single tango

indicators.note: in places the one among the letters that are then rearranged
broadcast means scattered widely, as seed is sown, so the letters are thrown into a new order
without means lacking, so one letter is left out

blocks.note: the Roman numeral for one
taken as written
tango is T in the phonetic alphabet; only one of the two goes

explanation.surface: A contestant on the televised dance show performs without doing a tango.
explanation.walkthrough: Strictly Come Dancing is a popular British TV ballroom contest; here its name supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A lyricist writes the words for songs, contributing to musicals and other compositions.

clue.text: Pitch up with cards for set of photographers

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means read from bottom to top, so backwards

blocks.note: pitch is a black tarry substance
a pack is a deck of cards

explanation.surface: Someone sets up a tent with a deck of cards for a group of camera people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pitch up' suggests arriving or camping; pitch is the tarry substance.
explanation.definitionFit: The rat pack is a disparaging term for the pack of press photographers who pursue celebrities.

clue.text: Hospital within reach in poor quarter

indicators.note: within means inside, so one letter sits among the others

blocks.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital
to reach a place is to get to it

explanation.surface: A hospital is within reach in a deprived neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: G, then H, then ETTO.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghetto is a deprived, crowded district of a city, where a minority group lives.

clue.text: Eastern woman's entering light shade in capital

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so these letters are placed in the shade

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for eastern
a woman's possessions are hers
tan is a light brown colour

explanation.surface: An oriental woman steps into a pale shadow in a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Teheran, an older spelling of Tehran, is the capital city of Iran.

clue.text: Strong material hoisted above second exit

indicators.note: in a down clue, something hoisted is lifted upward, so it reads from the bottom

blocks.note: serge is a hard-wearing twilled fabric
S is the abbreviation for second

explanation.surface: Durable cloth is hauled up over a backup way out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Above' places the reversed fabric before S in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Egress is a formal word for a way out or the act of leaving a place.

clue.text: Substitute with good reputation

blocks.note: a stand-in takes another person's place
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: A replacement player arrives with a fine reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's standing is their status or esteem in the eyes of others.

clue.text: People objectively in cycle showing moral character

indicators.note: a cycle goes round and round, so the last letter moves round to the front

blocks.note: as in 'those who wait', a pronoun for people that can serve as an object

explanation.surface: Fair-minded cyclists show their good character.
explanation.walkthrough: Move the final E of THOSE round to the start.
explanation.definitionFit: An ethos is the distinctive spirit and guiding beliefs of a person, group or culture.

clue.text: Social division announced for group of players

indicators.note: something announced is spoken out, so it is the sound that matters

blocks.note: a caste is a hereditary social class

explanation.surface: A class divide is declared within a group of performers.
explanation.definitionFit: The cast is the set of actors appearing in a play or film.

clue.text: A research site followed by a scholar in US state

blocks.note: taken as written
a lab is where research is done
taken as written
an MA, Master of Arts, is a scholarly degree holder

explanation.surface: An academic visits a laboratory in a southern American state.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabama is a state in the south-east of the United States, capital Montgomery.

clue.text: Skill shown in spectacular theatre

indicators.note: shown in means displayed inside, so the letters lie within the next words

blocks.note: straddling the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: Talent is on display in a dazzling stage production.
explanation.definitionFit: Art can mean a practical craft or knack, as in the art of conversation.

clue.text: English doctor on film gets ban

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for English
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a medical degree
Argo is the 2012 Ben Affleck film

explanation.surface: A British physician appearing in a movie is barred.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official prohibition, especially on trade with a particular country.

clue.text: Reprove young child wearing a skate loosely close to rink

indicators.note: the close of a word is its end, so only the last letter is taken
loosely means without fixed form, so the letters are freely rearranged
something worn is put on around you, so these letters go inside the others

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
the final letter of rink
a tot is a small child

explanation.surface: A toddler wobbling on an ice skate near the rink's edge gets a telling-off.
explanation.walkthrough: The child sits inside the rearranged letters, splitting them into the two outer words of the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: To take someone to task is an idiom for scolding or criticising them severely.

clue.text: Diplomat disowning old jealousy

indicators.note: disowning means rejecting, so that letter is cast out of the word

blocks.note: an envoy is a diplomatic messenger
O is the abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: An ambassador rejects resentment from the past.
explanation.definitionFit: Envy is resentful longing for what someone else has, closely akin to jealousy.
